summary: A held seat's retention answer is read again only when a message or work it read changed, not every minute

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: A held seat still stops within a minute of its last unread message being read or its other run's work ending.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build restores the minute recheck; nothing is stored.
